Each of these homes sits inside a gated community with 24/7 security and access to a beach club, so the day to day is easy whether you stay a season or longer.

Three of them also open a door to ownership: Casa Bohemia and Sanara 28 are available to purchase, and Casa Crystal offers a three month rent-to-own period so you can live in the home before deciding. I will keep adding homes to this page as new options come up.
